articles.title: House SI / Iragüen Viñuela Arquitectos
english: Completed in 2023, House SI is located in Algarrobo, Chile. The design, crafted by Iragüen Viñuela Arquitectos, was commissioned for a couple moving from Iquique to be nearer to their children residing in Santiago. This project reflects a modern approach, integrating both functionality and aesthetics within the residential space.

The architecture harmonizes with its surrounding environment, utilizing local materials to resonate with the natural landscape. Large windows allow ample light to fill the interiors, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. Each room is designed to maximize views and comfort for the residents.

House SI serves as an embodiment of thoughtful residential design, promoting family connection while providing personal spaces. The seamless blending of indoor and outdoor areas encourages a lifestyle rooted in nature, ensuring that family gatherings and daily activities can flourish.
chinese: 這座名為House SI的住宅於2023年在智利阿爾加羅波完成。設計由Iragüen Viñuela Arquitectos負責，這是為一對夫妻所委託，他們希望從伊基克搬到這裡，以便更接近住在聖地亞哥的孩子們。這個項目在現代風格上充分考量了功能性與美學的融合。
該建築與周邊環境和諧共存，利用當地材料來呼應自然景觀。大窗戶讓充足的自然光照射到室內，營造出溫暖而宜人的氛圍。每個房間都旨在最大化視野與居民的舒適度。
House SI是深思熟慮的住宅設計的具體體現，促進家庭聯繫，同時提供私人空間。室內外區域的無縫融合鼓勵著根植於自然的生活方式，確保家庭聚會和日常活動得以蓬勃發展。

articles.title: Toronto completes one of largest North American underground rail lines in decades
english: Toronto has completed the 19-kilometre metro Line 5 – Eglinton, featuring 15 underground stations that integrate into the Midtown urban landscape. Despite facing delays, this light rail transit system has opened to the public, creating a crucial link between various train lines and facilitating cross-town travel for an expanding population.

Designed by a collaborative team led by Arcadis and AtkinsRéalis, the stations showcase different typologies such as corner and pavilion designs. Each station aims to have a unified visual identity, maximizing natural light and creating a welcoming atmosphere, particularly at night when they glow like beacons.

The project is a significant achievement for a city that hadn't expanded its transit systems in over six decades, offering modern amenities such as plazas and bike shelters. The integration of eco-friendly designs and advanced engineering techniques highlights Toronto's commitment to sustainable urban development.
chinese: 多倫多完成了19公里長的地鐵5號線——埃格林頓線，擁有15個與市中心中城地區相結合的地下車站。儘管面臨延遲，這一輕軌系統已對公眾開放，為不斷增長的人口提供了多條火車線之間的重要連接，促進了跨城旅行。
由Arcadis和AtkinsRéalis領導的設計團隊展示了不同的站點類型，如拐角站和 Pavilion樣式。每個車站都致力於創建統一的視覺形象，最大化自然光的利用，尤其是在夜間，車站如同燈塔般閃爍，營造出友好的氛圍。
該項目對於六十多年來未擴大交通系統的城市而言，無疑是一項重要成就，並提供了現代化的設施，如廣場和自行車棚。綠色設計和先進工程技術的整合突顯了多倫多對可持續城市發展的承諾。

articles.topic: Kengo Kuma's Expansion of London's National Gallery
articles.title: kengo kuma wins competition to expand london’s national gallery with new wing
english: Kengo Kuma and Associates, alongside BDP and MICA, has won the prestigious competition to design a new wing for the National Gallery in London as part of the £750 million Project Domani. This proposal stood out among 65 submissions, admired for its architectural clarity and sensitivity to the historic context of the institution. The expansion represents a significant transformation in the Gallery's 200-year history, enhancing spaces for an extended collection of Western art.

The design merges continuity and contrast, with lower galleries featuring arched forms harmonizing with the existing Sainsbury Wing and North Galleries. Meanwhile, the upper levels offer a geometric expression that alters the atmosphere as visitors navigate the space. Utilizing Portland stone and incorporating stepped massing, Kuma's design establishes a dialogue with its urban surroundings and fosters connections between key public squares.

Moreover, the proposal emphasizes sustainability through a dedicated design framework that addresses climate and social action. The new wing, situated on the site of St. Vincent House, completes the National Gallery’s campus and is a pivotal step for its long-term growth. With considerable funding already secured, Project Domani aims to broaden the Gallery's curatorial scope and solidify its role within London's cultural landscape.
chinese: 隨著BDP 和 MICA 的合作，隈研吾與他的設計事務所贏得了著名的競賽，旨在為倫敦國家美術館設計一座新的展館，此計劃為750萬英鎊的「Project Domani」的一部分。這份提案在65個提交中脫穎而出，因其建築的清晰度與對機構歷史背景的敏感性而受到讚譽。這次擴建標誌著美術館200年歷史中的重要變革，增強了西方藝術延伸收藏的空間。
該設計融合了連貫性和對比，底層畫廊採用了與現有的Sainsbury Wing 和North Galleries 和諧的拱形造型。而上層則以幾何表達提供與空間氛圍的變化。使用波特蘭石材及分層質量，隈的設計與城市環境建立對話，並促進了主要公共廣場之間的連結。
此外，該提案強調可持續性，通過一個專門的設計框架來應對氣候和社會行動。在聖文森特大廈的基址上，這座新展館將完成國家美術館的校園，是其長期增長的重要一步。隨著相當可觀的資金獲得，Project Domani旨在擴大美術館的策展範疇，鞏固其在倫敦文化景觀中的地位。
